{{Quote|My name is Tyrral. I am the local trader for these parts. I sell goods to adventurers such as yourself.|Tyrral, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SG" />}}
'''Tyrral's Mercantile''' was a shop run by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Tyrral]] on [[Station Gamma]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the shop was based on [[Station Gamma]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. As Station Gamma had been overran by the [[Rak'qua]], a tribe of bellicose [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], Tyrral preferred to keep his business in the neutral area at the entrance of the station. There, he sold items such as [[Stimpack/Legends|stimpacks]] and [[Tatooine bug juice]] to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] brave enough to explore the depths of Station Gamma.<ref name="SWG:SG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyrral's Mercantile appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SG" /> prior to the game's closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tyrral's Mercantile was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]],"<ref name="SWG:SG" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
